question: What outcome is promised through fasting by day in this practice?
premises: Death associated with age is named
A future going beyond it is stated
inference: Through fasting by day, one will go beyond death by aging.
uncertainties: The exact sense of gamiṣyate with mṛtyuṃ may imply overcoming or passing beyond death
plain_english: By fasting during the day, one will go beyond death by aging.
